commands.command: set -e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "613c6d427b4b753aab3c5aa05d73815f4fadb01e"; SDK="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platforms/android-36/android.jar"; echo '=== AUDIOATTRIBUTES PUBLIC API ==='; javap -classpath "$SDK" android.media.AudioAttributes | grep -E 'USAGE_|CALL_ASSISTANT|setSystemUsage|setUsage' || true; echo '=== AUDIOTRACK PUBLIC API ==='; javap -classpath "$SDK" android.media.AudioTrack | grep -E 'CALL_ASSISTANT|setPreferredDevice|setAudioAttributes|Builder|setBufferSize|setTransferMode' || true; echo '=== POLICY XML INCALL ==='; SERIAL=192.168.0.100:34771; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'for f in /vendor/etc/audio_policy_configuration.xml /vendor/etc/*audio*policy*.xml /odm/etc/*audio*policy*.xml; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo FILE:$f; grep -n -B 8 -A 14 -E "incall_music_uplink|Telephony Tx|AUDIO_OUTPUT_FLAG_INCALL_MUSIC" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done' | head -n 500; echo api_policy_audit_complete=true
